description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardMediaInsertion' that manages media insertion functionality within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles media types supported, media request callbacks, and interactions with input connections for inserting media content such as images and GIFs.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardMediaInsertion
classes.description: An abstract class managing media insertion capabilities, including supported media types, handling media requests, and inserting media content into input connections.

classes.name: AskInsertionRequestCallback
classes.description: Inner class implementing InsertionRequestCallback to handle media request completion and cancellation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes remote insertion and request callback when the service is created.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, specifically destroying the remote insertion instance.

methods.name: createRemoteInsertion
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RemoteInsertion instance.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Prepares supported media types based on the current input editor info, and handles pending media requests.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Clears supported media types when input view is finished.

methods.name: handleMediaInsertionKey
methods.description: Initiates a media request when the media insertion key is pressed.

methods.name: getIdForInsertionRequest
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for media insertion requests based on EditorInfo.

methods.name: getSupportedMediaTypesForInput
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of supported media types.

methods.name: onMediaInsertionReply
methods.description: Handles the reply from media insertion requests, either committing media or queuing pending requests.

methods.name: commitMediaToInputConnection
methods.description: Commits media content to the current input connection.
